title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Enterprise security update: inference hooks GA, EDR sensor support in Cowork (beta)
bullets.summary: Anthropic made prompt and pre-tool-call inference hooks generally available, added a security center and centralized management (beta), and added EDR sensor support in Cowork (beta); the Developer Platform also gained a beta IP allowlist and an Admin API sign-out endpoint.
bullets.how: The Construct: GA pre-tool-call hooks are a native place to enforce guardrails on scheduled routines and the Mac runner. PRAGMA: concrete governance/security selling point for client agent deployments. Brand 9 Signs: indirect.

bullets.title: Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: video generation/editing with 15-second clips, 30% price cut
bullets.summary: Google released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash for video generation and follow-up editing, 15-second clips at about $0.07/second at 720p (per Google's launch post, via a daily digest).
bullets.how: The Construct: cheap video-gen option to compare against Higgsfield/Runway for ad and social clips. Brand 9 Signs: low-cost animated sign mockups and product social videos (still subject to the not-AI-generated claims gate). PRAGMA: cost benchmark for client content pipelines.

bullets.title: Rerun: no-code always-on agents with approval gates, open-source self-hostable
bullets.summary: Rerun launched always-on agents for inbox monitoring and recurring tasks with human approval gates and a self-hostable open-source option (Product Hunt listing; unverified beyond that).
bullets.how: The Construct: reference design for approval-gated scheduled agents like our routines. PRAGMA: self-hostable option suits privacy-sensitive clients. Brand 9 Signs: possible inbox triage for quote requests.

bullets.title: Claude Mythos 5.5 reference spotted (unconfirmed release)
bullets.summary: TestingCatalog reports a 'Claude Mythos 5.5' reference on Anthropic's Mythos page (cybersecurity/biology class) and unconfirmed A/B tests of updated Fable 5.5 checkpoints; no specs or announcement, and Mythos access has been limited to verified defenders.
bullets.how: The Construct: watch for a Fable 5.5 default-model change that would affect routine behavior and cost. PRAGMA: nothing actionable until announced. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Mistral Studio managed agents enter public preview
bullets.summary: Agents SDK, visual workflow builder and managed agents are in public preview, with private cloud and on-prem deployment planned for late November.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: on-prem/private-cloud option for clients who cannot use US-hosted agents. The Construct: comparison point for our orchestration layer. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Agent deployments are now judged on controls: GA inference hooks and approval gates (Anthropic, Rerun) are becoming table stakes, so wire hook-based guardrails and approval steps into The Construct's routines and package them as part of PRAGMA engagements. (Caveats: from daily digests and release trackers; Mythos 5.5 is unconfirmed; no verified signage/CRM/DAM/real-estate MCP news and no Meta/xAI/DeepSeek/Cohere launches in the last 24h, so those are omitted.)
